lines.li: [them] I hear this place is new, and that {MOTHERCOLONY} founded it.
[us] It is, and there's a lot still to do.
[them,their:empire] Then may the holding prove worthy of the honor of its founding.
[them,their:tribal] Then the spirits of this land are still learning your names.
[them,their:medieval] Then you'll want a good wall up before the winter, aye.
[them,their:hightech] Then you'll be building for a good while yet.
[them] Then good luck to you, the first year is the hardest.
[us] So everyone tells us.
[them] So this is the colony's new place.
[us] It is, still more plans than walls.
[them,their:lowtech] It will grow, as a young fire does.
[them] It's coming along, I can see that.
[them] The court takes note of every new holding, and it will have noted yours.
[us] I hope it noted something good.
[them,us:noble] A noble of the Empire lives here, so it will be watching closely.
[them] It noted that you hold the land, and holding is the beginning of honor.
[them] They say the colony gave {HANDEDOVER} to its own people.
[us] It did, it belongs to the {HANDEDPEOPLE} now.
[them,their:empire] A holding given away with no title asked for it, how unlike the court.
[them,their:tribal] A fire given away is still warm, the elders say.
[them,their:medieval] A free town, then, with its own charter, aye.
[them] Not many would give a whole town away.
[us] It was theirs as much as ours.
[them] I'll be calling at {HANDEDOVER} on my way, now it trades on its own.
[us] Be fair with them, they're good people.
[them] I'm fair with everyone, it's good for business.
[them] I hear {TOOKBACK} is the colony's again.
[us] It is, by its own people's word.
[them,their:empire] A holding returned to those who first held it, the court would approve.
[them,their:medieval] Then the old charter's back in the hands that wrote it, aye.
[them,their:tribal] Two fires made one again, that is good to hear.
[them] Good, a place should be with the people who built it.
